notes.title: Knight's End - The final game in the Skautfold series coming this Halloween.
notes.content:
The Finale has taken shape.

The last game in the Skautfold story-ark will be titled Knight's End, will feature Len the First Knight, and take place only days before the inevitable destruction of life on earth.

Gameplay will be a mix of exploration and a separate screen timeline based combat system, with active defensive and aggressive play using the final iteration of the Guard system.

Planned release date is this Halloween, so October 31st.




If you wish to know more in detail read on.

Story:
The finale will follow the First Knight Lennecia as she undertakes a personal journey to save Saragat from a rather unfortunate fate. To do this she will venture onto the now abandoned Waltham Industries factory site, and delve deep into its secrets, facing the worst possible adversary for such a mission, Waltham himself. 
The story takes place only days prior to the now broken Moon's pieces laying absolute and final destruction to all complex life on Earth, and just before the Human built Citadel is to take off from London with as many humans as it can carry for a possible escape.
The story wont revolve around some contrived way to save humanity from the pieces of the Moon, but rather her personal mission to save Saragat from a horrible fate that awaits him.

Gameplay:
Exploration will be very similar to the original game Shrouded in Sanity, with easier navigation.
Expect a similar style an atmosphere as you delve into Waltham's deepest secrets on his factory grounds and below.
However Combat will take place on a different screen, akin to jrpgs where you are transported on contact with the enemy.
Combat uses a timeline based system where actions take time to execute and have different cooldowns, both for you and the enemy. At all times you can see exactly what the order is via the visible timeline, allowing for precise planning.
Unlike most turn based rpgs you CAN an should actively defend yourself, minimising downtime and rewarding good timing, using the correct defensive action, or taking a bigger risk attempting to parry.
Each of your attacks have a status effect tied to them, with 3 different types of qtes to increase damage and chance of applying the status tied to the weapon.
Good timing on defensive and offensive actions will reward you with Chain, a resource you can use to unleash one of three different finishers, all playing into the rock paper scissor style weakness system, where the old-school combat triangle comes into play.
The battlefield will be reactive in that all attacks will leave a mark, so by the end of some fights it will get quiet messy.

All in all combat may sound complex, but its far easier to understand in practice, and I worked hard to ensure its far more engaging than the old-school simple turn based combat systems of the past. Controls are fast simplified to ensure no slow and cumbersome menu browsing will occur.

notes.title: Shrouded in Sanity 2.0
notes.content:
Due to an upcoming console port opportunity, Shrouded in Sanity will receive a massive update.

This will mostly include total overhauls of many systems, graphical fixes, changes and updates. Serious optimization in many areas, and a bit of new and restored content.

So far I have already recreated most core systems from the ground up, things like:
-How ALL text is stored, and displayed.
-The entire input read and handling system, added gamepad mapping.
-The whole state machine remade from the ground up.
-Separated npc functions into separate objects instead of cumbersome menus.
-Fixed a lot of balance issues.
-Made the torch function as intended with a more obvious highlight to show when to shoot.
-Plenty of visual changes.

The intention is to update and fix, and clean up wherever possible while still keeping to the original tone, atmosphere and feel of the game.

I will also attempt to finish and restore cut content, such as 1 more boss, 1 more plot important npc, and 1 new zone. All of them were intended, and most still exist in the files as half finished assets.

When its finished it will have a full breakdown of changes in a massive patch note update.

I have no time estimate for this as this is an entirely new task I never had to do before, and plenty of unexpected issues have already popped their head up since I have started on the restoration.

notes.title: Usurper (Sequel to SiS) is out now into Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Usurper is out now into Early Access, but first, please read this disclaimer about Early Access before continuing, or buying Usurper in its current state:

DISCLAIMER

Since this is an Early Access game, we remind you that whilst the entire story is complete, there are a lot of features missing or imcomplete. Therefore, if you wish to play the full feature-complete game first time, we suggest you wait until Usurper comes out of Early Access.

We will NOT be increasing the price of the game once it comes out of Early Access, so you don't need to worry about the cost when deciding when to buy the game. We'd much rather you bought the version of the game you will be happiest with. During Usurper's time in Early Access, we expect there to be a host of balancing issues, particularly due to different stat builds. notes.title: Fan Art Competition - The Results!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's the moment you've been waiting for - the results of the fan art competition are in!

Just before we announce the winners, a HUGE thank you to everyone that entered the competition. We hope you all enjoyed taking part, and we both genuinely found it incredibly difficult choosing the winners - despite there being only 6 entries. There was a very high standard of entries, not only in terms of art ability, but also in terms of imagination and creativity. Put it this way - we sat down for 45 minutes to debate who the winners would be - it was not an easy task!

 And so the winners are...

Without further ado, here are the winners, with links to their art, and our reasoning behind the decisions further below:

1st place: VulpusAlbus - SiS Cartoon
2nd place: BenWolfers - Shrouded in Beach
3rd place: Toanterror - Shrouded in Sanity

1st place - VulpusAlbus - Shrouded in Sanity Cartoon

Click to view

We absolutely loved the creativity in this one! It was a very different kind of submission to the others, which made it stand out - perhaps in a way we were not expecting, which made it all the more appealing. The plasticene style won us over, and made us smile in delight! You can tell Vulpus put in a lot of effort and played to their strengths, resulting in a really unique and creative bit of work. Well done!

2nd place - BenWolfers - Shrouded in Beach

Click to view

A really fun take on SiS - what's not to love?! Saragat, wide-eyed in swimwear, whilst in the background what we can only presume to be one-half of the "love couple" from the manor is being chased by a maid. Fantastic! It also has more neat references - the revolver, and the pocketwatch to name just two. All in all, a lot of fun - and it made us smile a heck of a lot! Well done!

3rd place - Toanterror - Shrouded in Sanity

 Click to view

What can we say? Beautiful. Yeah. That about sums this one up! Seriously gorgeous artwork. It conjures up the story well; blood on the blade, the death screen via the pocketwatch, and then there's the whole beckoning glyph. The attention to detail, and sheer time it must've taken to create this makes this a really solid 3rd place. A really lovely bit of art that is worthy of being cover art. Once again, beautiful! Well done!

To All Entrants

Once again, huge congratulations to the winners, but also a really hearty pat on the back to all those that entered. You all showed a lot of effort and made us both smile with joy at your fan art. We hope you all enjoyed taking part, and really hope none of you leave feeling disheartened. Please feel free to upload your fan art onto the artwork section of Shrouded in Sanity on Steam!

IMPORTANT

To all entrants, Steve or Jam will be sending your prizes via PM either on Steam or Discord, so please make sure you have enabled communication/direct messaging if you haven't already. We will also take your details of the gravestone or pet reward this way.

Prizes will be distributed either later today or whenever we get a private venue to exchange them.

Don't forget, everyone that took part gets a key to the SiS OST, whether you won or not!

Closing words

We really hope you enjoyed that competition - we certainly did - even if judging was difficult!

For those that still want to send in fan art, please do so! We absolutely squeel in delight at seeing it. 

You can either upload fan art to the artwork tabs on either game on Steam, or even post it in our Discord server. As a rule of thumb, Steve and Jam are usually on there from 10am - 10pm GMT/UTC+1 every day - so drop in and say hi!

And that's a wrap - see ya next time!

Pugware

notes.title: It's Competition Time! (w/ prizes of course)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Alright, time for a bit of fun! As a token of our appreciation to our awesome fanbase (that's you guys and gals), we want to give you all a fun little competition (with prizes - we'll get to that in a bit) to get your teeth stuck into.

As developers, we love it when people enjoy the game so much that they make fan art. It absolutely thrills us when people spend their own spare time drawing what they love (and maybe even what they hated!) about our games. And so we figured "Well, instead of getting people to 'like and share a post' in order to enter a competition... let's get them to be creative and show us their fan art!". To make things even more creative, should you win first prize, your very own design (subject of which is mentioned later) will make it into the game itself!

About the competiton:

1) This will not just be judged on a "who can draw the best?" basis. We want to open this up to as many people as possible, regardless of artistic ability. We don't want people to feel left out, or feel they couldn't possibly enter... so whilst artistic talent will account for a small %age of the points, we'll also be picking the top three entries under terms such as "creativity, interpretation, uniqueness" etc. 

3) You can post your artwork anywhere that's convenient for you (i.e. Our Discord, Twitter, on our Steam forums, Imgur, FlickR, your own website etc.). The only proviso for entering is that you send us a link to it in the comments on this announcement. If you'd rather send us a DM through Steam, you can do.

4) The fanart can be of either Shrouded in Sanity or Usurper. You could even do something Lovecraftian, although we'd prefer it if it related to either game since that's more fitting.

5) The submission date for this will be Sunday the 3rd of September at 10pm GMT/UTC+1 (Sorry about the +1, British Summer Time and all that) So that means you have just a little shy of 2 weeks. We know it's not a long deadline, but we can't leave it too much later.

The prizes:

It wouldn't be a competition without prizes...

1st place:
- Your very own pet design to be implemented into Usurper
- 3x Steam keys of Usurper for you and 2 friends
- 3x Steam keys for Shrouded in Sanity OST DLC

2nd place:
- Special gravestone in-game for one person (that sounded more morbid than we realised initially)
- 2x Steam keys for Usurper
- 2x Steam keys for Shrouded in Sanity OST DLC

3rd place:
- 1x Steam key for Usurper
- 1x Steam key for Shrouded in Sanity OST DLC

Everyone that entered (that's right, everyone!):
- 1x Steam key for Shrouded in Sanity OST DLC (We will only give one key per person, regardless of the number of submissions by that person)

Important Notes:

- All prizes will be given out as soon as such items are available (so after Early Access, and once the game and DLC has been fully released). Since the game and DLC has not yet been released, Steam handles keys as if they are pre-purchases.

- For the pet reward, we will not use a design lifted from anything that already exists, or anything that bears a significant enough resemblance. We also won't be using things that could be deemed offensive, sexually suggestive (within reason, I mean Lovecraft and all that can be slightly suggestive at times)

- If you have an idea for the pet, but don't know how to draw it, Steve is happy to take on the challenge. He will obviously have to copy and ammend any drawing himself anyway, so this is no extra bother.

- For the gravestone reward, we will not accept profanities or content of an offensive nature. We reserve the right to use a little discretion and may ask you to revise if necessary. 

- We will allow multiple submissions per person, but you can only win one place (i.e. you can't come 1st and 2nd, 2nd and 3rd, or 1st and 3rd). That would be unfair.

- We will not allow a group submission (we can't split the prizes between mutliple people, but you can of course share any prizes you win with others).

 Finally... 

So that about sums it up. Go forth and think about what you could draw, and like we said - don't worry too much about your artistic talents. All we ask for is a decent amount of effort and thought. 

Don't forget about our official Pugware Discord Server, where you can conveniently find out anything you've ever wanted to know about SiS or Usurper - There are dedicated rooms for updates, spoilers, general chat and more. Both Steve and Jam are usually around between 10am - 10pm GMT/UTC+1 every day.

We can't wait to see your fan art, and the very best of luck!

Pugware

notes.title: Update 4 Live, experimental battle system.
notes.content:
Battle system overhaul.

Introducing the Guard resource.
This new resource will server as your first line of defense. When taking damage if you have guard left that will take the hit, instead of your health.

Guard is regained automatically similar to stamina, however, dodging through attacks or a successful parry will regain a lot more guard immediately.

All actions cost guard, however even if  your guard is under zero, you can still preform all actions, as opposed to stamina. This allows you to escape, or push more, but also risk taking damage.

This is an experimental update, previous version is archived and can be restored easily. If this version proves unpopular rollback is possible.

Thank you for reading and hope you`ll find the new system more rewarding.
